description: Example sanitized CommunityReport records, shaped for a seed script. Illustrates what publication looks like after redaction -- no personal phone numbers/emails, only scammer-side technical indicators.

examples.ai_summary: Message impersonates HDFC Bank, claims KYC has expired, and pressures the recipient to click a look-alike verification link.
Message claims a package is held for a small customs fee and directs the recipient to an unofficial payment link.
Unsolicited high-pay work-from-home offer asking the recipient to install a task app and pay a refundable registration fee.
